logline: Sera Voss oversees a routine sanctioned killing in a cold alley at dawn.
visualHook: Sera's scarred hands steady a trembling victim as the Silence falls.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera carries out a sanctioned kill and records it on her Tallybone.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Another notch carved into bone; another fragment of a stranger's memory lodges in her mind.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Establishes Sera's daily reality as a Death Warden burdened by centuries of killing.

logline: Sera walks the aftermath, Ashen Compass steady in her grip.
visualHook: The compass needle glows warm amber, pulling toward the fresh kill.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera confirms the kill location with the Compass and prepares to file her report.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Routine feels hollow as a dead woman's childhood memory of rain surfaces unbidden.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Shows Sera's psychic erosion from accumulated Death Debts during normal work.

logline: The Ashen Compass goes dark for the first time in seven centuries.
visualHook: The needle spins wildly, then stops dead — no glow, no pull, nothing.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera stares at the dead Compass, trying to force it to respond.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: The tool that defines her profession has never failed before; something unprecedented has happened.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The central mystery ignites — the Compass detects no intentional killing, defying all known law.

logline: Sera is summoned to a tenement where a body lies still.
visualHook: A cramped room, a body on a cot, no blood, no wound — just stillness.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera arrives at the secondary scene and begins her examination.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: The victim has no scar, no wound, and no silence — the body simply stopped.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera faces a death that exists outside every framework she knows.

logline: The Dying Candle in the room burns normally — no killer nearby.
visualHook: A candle flame leans warm and golden, casting light, not shadow.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera checks the Dying Candle and finds no confession of murder.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: No one who killed within the last year has been near this body.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Every tool of investigation confirms the impossible: this was not a killing.

logline: Neighbors say the victim was perfectly fine yesterday.
visualHook: A child-faced neighbor speaks with centuries-old eyes about yesterday's friend.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera interviews the tenement neighbors about the victim's final hours.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: No one heard the Silence of the Dying fall — because it never fell.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The absence of the Silence becomes evidence itself: no murder occurred.

logline: Sera consults the Tallybone records for any death warrant on the victim.
visualHook: Pages of carved bone-clicks echo in the silent archive hall.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera searches the Warden archives for any sanctioned warrant on this person.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: No warrant, no enemies, no bounty — the victim had no reason to die.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The bureaucratic machinery of death has no record that explains this body.

logline: The victim has been registered as age forty-three for six hundred years.
visualHook: A registry page yellow with age shows the same entry, unchanged for centuries.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera cross-references the victim's registration age against the body's condition.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: The body shows decay consistent with aging — but the Age Lock should make that impossible.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The Stillness itself may be breaking, threatening the foundation of all civilization.

logline: By every law of Aeternum, this death is impossible.
visualHook: Sera's hands tremble over the body as the implications crystallize.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera synthesizes all evidence and reaches a forbidden conclusion.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: If word spreads, the entire economy of killing becomes irrelevant.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The impossible death transforms from a puzzle into an existential threat to the regime.

logline: A dead victim's memory surfaces, mixing with the crime scene.
visualHook: Sera sees the tenement overlaid with someone else's childhood garden.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: An accumulated Death Debt memory erupts unbidden, distorting Sera's perception.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Sera can no longer trust whether what she sees is real or inherited.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera's fractured identity becomes an active obstacle to the investigation.

logline: Sera reaches for Veins of Lethe to clear her fracturing mind.
visualHook: Sera's fingers close around an empty vial — the last grains of Lethe dust.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera seeks out her Lethe supplier in the lower districts.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Her usual contact has nothing to give her.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera's coping mechanism for centuries of Death Debts is suddenly severed.

logline: The supplier reveals Marchand has restricted all Lethe distribution.
visualHook: A nervous supplier whispers behind a sealed door, eyes darting.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: The supplier tells Sera that High Warden Marchand cut off all Lethe flow on special order.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Every Warden dependent on Lethe is now trapped with their accumulating Death Debts.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Marchand's move signals he anticipated this crisis and is tightening control before it breaks.

logline: High Warden Marchand arrives at the scene before Sera reports.
visualHook: Marchand steps through the tenement door, calm and preemptive, as if he expected this.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Marchand appears at the body before Sera can file her findings with Warden command.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: His early arrival proves he already knew about the impossible death.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The antagonist reveals himself as someone hiding the truth rather than seeking it.

logline: Marchand confiscates the body under an ancient containment protocol.
visualHook: Marchand's gloved hand seals the body in a black shroud marked with a centuries-old sigil.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Marchand invokes a containment protocol unused since the Memory Flood to seize the body.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Sera's only physical evidence is taken from her under lawful authority.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The investigation's central evidence is now in the antagonist's hands.

logline: Marchand tells Sera the case is closed — natural causes, rare anomaly.
visualHook: Marchand's smile doesn't reach his eyes as he dismisses the impossible.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Marchand orders Sera to accept the death as a rare anomaly and move on.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Sera is officially forbidden from investigating further under Warden authority.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera must choose between obedience and the truth that could free her from her Debts.

logline: Sera disobeys Marchand and commits to finding the truth.
visualHook: Sera walks past Warden headquarters without entering, turning toward the quarantine walls.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera decides to investigate the impossible death on her own, defying Marchand's order.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: She crosses from sanctioned Warden to rogue investigator in a single step.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera commits to a path that will make her an enemy of the regime she served.

logline: Sera enters the quarantined Memory Flood district seeking a rogue alchemist.
visualHook: Rusting quarantine gates groan open to streets where people whisper to themselves.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera breaches the century-old quarantine to find the alchemist who studied the Stillness.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: She enters a landscape of perpetual psychic torment where residents relive thousands of murders.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera enters a zone outside all law and protection, raising the stakes of her search.

logline: The quarantine streets are filled with people drowning in murdered memories.
visualHook: A woman rocks on the ground weeping in three different voices at once.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera navigates the haunted district, dodging residents lost in other people's deaths.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: The district's suffering mirrors what Sera's own Death Debts will become without Lethe.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera sees her own future in the quarantined — a preview of her fate if the Debts keep accumulating.

logline: Sera finds the rogue alchemist hiding in a collapsed apothecary.
visualHook: An old woman's body sits behind a wall of shattered glass vials, surrounded by centuries of notes.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera locates the alchemist who was exiled for studying the Stillness itself.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: The alchemist has spent centuries developing a theory no one else dared voice.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: A new source of forbidden knowledge enters the story, outside Marchand's control.

logline: The alchemist reveals the Stillness was never permanent — only paused.
visualHook: The alchemist draws a breath, holds it, then releases — 'Like that. The world held its breath.'

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: The alchemist explains her theory that the Stillness was a pause, not a permanent state.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: If correct, aging will resume for everyone — the foundation of Aeternum is temporary.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The impossible death transforms from anomaly into the first symptom of a global change.

logline: The alchemist warns: the body Sera found is just the first to resume aging.
visualHook: The alchemist grabs Sera's wrist with surprising strength. 'You found the first. There will be more.'

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: The alchemist tells Sera the death she discovered is the beginning, not an isolated event.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: If the Stillness is ending, every institution built on eternal life will collapse.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The stakes escalate from one impossible death to the potential end of civilization as known.

logline: Marchand's agents ambush Sera inside the quarantine zone.
visualHook: Three figures in Warden black step from the fog of the quarantine streets.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Marchand's agents corner Sera in the Memory Flood district to silence her.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Sera is trapped between hostile agents and a district full of dangers.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Marchand escalates from bureaucratic suppression to direct violent intervention.

logline: Sera kills one agent in self-defense and the Silence of the Dying falls.
visualHook: All sound vanishes within ten paces — the breath of silence grips the quarantine street.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera kills an attacking agent to save her own life.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: The Silence falls for the first time in Sera's life outside a sanctioned kill, and she inherits the agent's final memories.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera crosses the line from investigator to killer outside the law.

logline: The dead agent's final memory reveals Marchand's vault full of aged bodies.
visualHook: In Sera's mind: a stone vault, cold and dark, stacked with dozens of shriveled, aged corpses.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera experiences the dead agent's last memory — a vision of Marchand's secret vault.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: The impossible death isn't the first; Marchand has been collecting them for an unknown period.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The conspiracy expands: Marchand isn't just hiding one death, he's hoarding evidence of many.

logline: Sera escapes the quarantine zone, carrying a dead agent's memory.
visualHook: Sera stumbles through rusted gates, bleeding from a wound that will scar forever.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera flees the quarantine district with the surviving agents in pursuit.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: She carries proof of Marchand's conspiracy in her own mind, but no physical evidence.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera is now both witness and fugitive, carrying the regime's most dangerous secret.

logline: Sera returns to Warden HQ and finds Marchand has already moved against her.
visualHook: Sera's Tallybone crumbles to dust in her hands as she crosses the threshold.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera discovers Marchand has formally charged her with unsanctioned killing.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Her Tallybone is stripped, her Warden authority revoked, and a kill warrant issued in her name.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera is transformed from enforcer to quarry in the system she served for centuries.

logline: Sera is now a fugitive hunted by the Wardens she once led.
visualHook: Wanted posters bearing Sera's scarred face appear on every corner within the hour.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera goes to ground, hiding from the Warden network that knows her every habit.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Every ally she had is now legally required to kill her on sight.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera is completely isolated with the truth and no means to spread it safely.

logline: Cornered and desperate, Sera finds a Mourner's Bell in an abandoned shrine.
visualHook: A tarnished bell hangs from a rotted frame in a shrine no one has visited in decades.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera reaches for the Mourner's Bell as her last resort to make the truth felt.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: The Bell will force everyone who hears it to experience the emotional state of the most recently killed person.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: Sera chooses to weaponize empathy itself — making the impossible death undeniable to the masses.

logline: Sera rings the Mourner's Bell in a crowded public square.
visualHook: The bell's tone cuts through market noise, and hundreds freeze mid-motion.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: Sera strikes the Mourner's Bell in the most crowded square in Aeternum.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: Hundreds of civilians are forced to feel the emotional state of the impossible victim — the peace of a natural death.
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The truth of mortality escapes containment and enters the minds of the public directly.

logline: The crowd experiences natural death for the first time — terror or hope?
visualHook: Faces in the crowd shift from horror to wonder to tears, one by one, as the bell's resonance fades.

setupsPayoffs.actionTaken: The crowd processes a sensation none of them have ever known — the peace of dying without murder.
setupsPayoffs.consequence: The question hangs in the air: is the return of natural death the end of their world, or its liberation?
setupsPayoffs.storyStateChange: The episode ends on the cliffhanger of a civilization confronting the possibility of its own transformation.
